hook: BRS asks why AP's *9 TMCft* Sagar plan went unnoticed
hook_b: BRS asks why AP's *9 TMCft* Sagar plan went unnoticed
tldr: BRS working president KT Rama Rao asked the Telangana government whether it had complained to the Krishna River Management Board about Andhra Pradesh's alleged project to draw 9 TMCft from Nagarjuna Sagar. He warned of agitation and a legal fight. The government's reply is not in the report.

beats.what: At Telangana Bhavan on Nov 18, KTR asked if the State had approached KRMB, lodged a complaint or sought the remaining 40 TMCft for drinking water.
beats.why: Reports earlier this week said AP is building a tunnel to draw Krishna water from Nagarjuna Sagar, which supplies Hyderabad and several districts.
beats.care: Nagarjuna Sagar is a drinking-water source for Hyderabad; any shift in Krishna shares matters for summer supply.
